summary_1line: The gods enlist Agni to produce a son who will defeat Taraka, leading to the miraculous birth of Kartikeya from Agni’s seed carried by Ganga.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ganga, overwhelmed by the blazing seed of Agni, casts the radiant golden embryo onto Mount Meru where it illuminates the mountain like a second sun.
The gods discover Agni hidden within the heart of a Sami tree after a parrot reveals his secret hiding place.
In a forest of reeds, the brilliant child Kartikeya shines like the rising sun as the goddess Krittika lifts him and nurses him as her son.
